subject: general
question: ﻿The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill 2022 proposed to convert _______ as Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya.
solution:
The answer is the __**National Rail and Transportation Institute.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill 2022 proposed to convert an existing central university into Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya, which will focus on transportation and infrastructure studies.**
 
• The key word in the question is "Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya," which translates to "University of Transportation and Infrastructure."
 
• The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2022 was passed in Lok Sabha in August.
 
• The Central Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2022 was introduced in Lok Sabha on August 1, 2022. 
 
• **The Bill amends the Central Universities Act, of 2009, w**hich provides for establishing central universities in various states. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Infrastructure and Industrial Institute** - This option is not correct as it does not focus specifically on transportation studies.
 
• **National Energy and Environment Institute** - This option is not correct as it does not focus specifically on transportation studies.
 
• **National Transport and Infrastructure Institute **- This option is similar to the correct option, but the exact name mentioned in the proposed bill is National Rail and Transportation Institute.
